text:
tara: Quick ask — need a small visual suite for next Tue launch push: benchmark hero, webinar registration modal, and a 30s social GIF. Low-fi frames in Figma below. Priority order: hero > signup modal > GIF. Brand-approved colorway only. Due Tue EOD PT. cc @giselle @kevin

giselle: On it. Can you paste the figma link and the baseline copy? Also, do we need APAC-sized assets?

tara: figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz-inference-econ-launch
Baseline copy: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost. Try Redwood Inference — hosted, dedicated, private.'
AB variants: 1) 'Predictable LLM inference — lower cost, less latency.' 2) 'Ship AI features faster with predictable performance.'
APAC: yes — need 1200x600 hero + square social.

kevin: For webinar CTA use 'Register — Seats limited'. We'll run 2 headline tests: cost-first vs latency-first. Keep hero flexible so we can swap headlines without reflowing layout.

giselle: Got it. I'll mock hero + signup modal by Fri. For GIF, do you want an animated sparkline of latency vs cost? I can do a simple looped animation (600x600).

liam: Add a note: include a small footnote: 'Benchmark results shown across standard production GPUs — contact us for specifics.' Keep it short.

maya: Legal note: please avoid naming specific chip models in external marketing. Use language like 'across standard production GPUs' as Liam suggested. I'll review copy variants once uploaded.

giselle: Thanks — will avoid chip names. Quick Q: font weight for CTA — brand uses Inter SemiBold (600), right?

tara: Yes Inter SemiBold 600. CTA color — double-check with brand: is it #FF4A4A or the updated token? @ash

ash: CTA color for launch bodies is #FF3B30. Use accessible contrast and include alt-high-contrast variant. I'll drop a token in the Figma file.

figmabot: Frame created: Launch_Hero_v1 — https://figma.com/frame/abc
Checklist auto-generated: hero (1200x600), social 1:1 (600x600), modal (480x320), GIF (600x600), source file attached.

giselle: Perfect — I'll upload early drafts to the Figma file and ping here when ready for copy/brand/legal sweep.

kevin: :thumbsup: One more ask — give me a distinct UTM for headline B so analytics can split traffic.

tara: Using this UTM for headline B:```
utm_campaign=launch_inference_econ
utm_source=social
utm_variant=headlineB
```
Thanks everyone — tagging the timeline: mock drafts Fri, internal review Mon, final assets Tue EOD PT.
